note: Nevada Irrigation District campground on a wooded peninsula of Rollins Lake, run by a concessionaire. It has a boat launch with some seasonal slips, a roped sandy swim beach, two fishing trails and a store. Meadow sites and the group coves take no RVs or trailers. --Claude
summary: Peninsula (NID, Rollins Lake): lakefront -> lakeview proposed (canopy to the shore, sites unplaceable); fees confirmed $57-75 + $12 reservation fee, extra car $22, pets $8, 8-person cap; operator booking (camping.com), 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums; season not written (closes 09-13, opens only "May"); 70 sites, RVs to 40 ft; Google 4.1 (79); possible pin move.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE lakefront -> lakeview (stored value is not --AWH). The operator sells a 'Lakefront' class ($75): sites 44-54 on The Point loop and 71 by the marina, per its map. But Esri imagery shows continuous conifer canopy down to the waterline all round the peninsula with no open ground, and neither imagery nor 3DEP hillshade resolves the loops, so no named site can be shown within ~50 m over open ground. A sales category alone is not evidence. Proposed evidence: 'Operator map marks Lakefront sites 44-54 (The Point) and 71, but Esri imagery 2026-11-26 shows continuous canopy to the full-pool shore with no resolvable pads; the 50 m open-ground test is unmet, so defaults down to lakeview.' If AWH knows The Point's sites sit on open ground at the water, lakefront could stand.

PIN: the stored 39.15544,-120.94711 is the marina/gatehouse parking at the NW end. Google's place point 39.151691,-120.9433551 is ~520 m SE along the peninsula road, among the loops. Only sites 71/72 and the cabins are near the stored pin, and the loops can't be placed exactly under canopy. Suggested target: 39.15169,-120.94336.
PRICE: $57-75 is over $50, but the entry is local (Nevada Irrigation District), so the private price gate does not apply.
MIN STAY: 2 nights on weekends, 3 on holidays (not a standing minimum).

SEASON not written: the page says 'closing for the season September 13, 2026, see you May 2027!' and archived pages give only 'May', so a half season (closes 09-13, no opens) was left out rather than guessing an opening day. Suggest opens/closes once NID posts the 2027 opening.
Old note's 'sloped, big-rig access with caveats' was not found on any page read; dropped.
Phone 530-477-9413 confirmed; websites unchanged (penresort.com, Google's listed site, redirects to orchardspringscampground.com).
Max stay: the reservation calendar mentions a 14-day limit only for dates starting on or before a highlighted date; not set.
